_README: Group 3 Sensor Intake Adapter Contract. One reusable shape for every sensor class feeding VANA. An adapter converts a source's native output into a frozen V2.2 observation; it never adds a canonical field or identity rule.
_owner: Hemanth Reddy - Primary System Integration Owner, Group 3
_authority_boundary: Adapters are Group 3 implementation. Canonical schema, provenance and identity rules remain with the contract owner and MDU. This file adds no field and proposes no contract change.

_status_summary._honesty: 1 of 5 adapters is implemented and proven. The rest are contract definitions with no code and, in most cases, no hardware. A DECLARED or RESERVED adapter must never be shown as a connected capability.

field_responsibility_split._what_this_answers: For a NEW sensor class, which fields does the adapter author have to think about?

identical_for_every_adapter.rule: Fixed by the contract or by Group 3 convention. contract_version is const 2.2; ingestion_timestamp and trace_id are runtime-owned and emitted null; idempotency_key is IK-<observation_id>.

adapter_must_supply.rule: These are what actually differ between one sensor class and another.

edge_runtime_supplies.rule: Common edge services, not per-adapter. Writing these per-adapter is how two sensors end up with inconsistent provenance.

transport_contract.host: Supplied at run time via --base-url or VANA_API_BASE_URL. NEVER committed - Group 1's API carries no authentication.
transport_contract.expected_sequence: 201 ACCEPTED -> 200 IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY (same key, same body) -> 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT (same key, mutated body)
transport_contract.retry_rule: The edge MUST persist the idempotency key alongside a buffered reading. A key regenerated after reboot creates a duplicate canonical record instead of a safe replay.

adapters.status: DECLARED - contract defined, no implementation, no hardware present
adapters.evidence: NONE. No Group 3 analog sensor has produced a reading.
adapters.source_read: ADC counts from the edge board
adapters.flight_id: BLOCKED on W6-3 - a fixed ground unit has no defined third segment
adapters.device_id_convention: A real Group 3 device identifier. MUST NOT use the G3-EXT- prefix, which is contractually bound to external_api
adapters.synthetic_state: CONTROLLED until every D5 readiness condition is met, then PHYSICAL
adapters.raw_artifact: The raw ADC counts / voltage, persisted BEFORE conversion
adapters.timestamp_source: EDGE clock - the sensor has none. See W6-2
adapters.location_source: GNSS receiver, or a surveyed coordinate
adapters.gnss_status: REAL VALUE - FIX / NO_FIX / DEGRADED from the receiver

adapters.sensor_class: Digital-bus sensor (RS485 DO, 1-Wire DS18B20, I2C BME280)

adapters.raw_artifact: The raw bus frame, persisted before decoding

It must not be cited as a LiDAR capability.

how_to_add_a_new_sensor_class: 1. Confirm the measurement, unit and observation_type - Suraj's sensor capability matrix.
2. Choose the adapter family: ANALOG_PROBE, DIGITAL_BUS or IMAGE_CAPTURE.
3. Implement ONLY the source read and the seven adapter-supplied fields.
4. Persist raw bytes, then hash them. Never hash without persisting.
5. Validate against the frozen schema before transmission.
6. POST with IK-<observation_id>; confirm 201, then replay for 200.
7. Do NOT add a canonical field. If something is not representable, raise it as a gap.

_open_blockers_for_any_hardware_adapter.W6-3: Fixed ground sensor has no defined observation_id third segment.
_open_blockers_for_any_hardware_adapter.W6-2: Clock-trust instruction names data_state UNCERTAIN, which is now invalid.
_open_blockers_for_any_hardware_adapter.G-33: hardware_verified is not returned by Group 1 - the PHYSICAL gate cannot be verified.
_open_blockers_for_any_hardware_adapter._effect: All three block PHYSICAL classification, not intake. A hardware adapter can emit truthfully as CONTROLLED today.
